svg.title: Tashfiqul Islam: I help engineers do their best work.
svg.desc: technical product manager, Engineering Enablement & Platform Modernization. The bridge between technology and people. Focus: developer experience, platform modernization and engineering enablement. 7+ years in technology, 5+ in product.
